title: Dunning Activities

Dunning Activities

Definition

Measure taken when a specific dunning level of a dunning procedure is reached.

Structure

You define dunning activities in the Customizing activity Configure Dunning Activities by specifying a function module with a
predefined interface. For the dunning activity key, specify the name of the dunning activity, the activity type, and the name of the
function module that executes the dunning activity. For activities that support the printing of Print Workbench forms, you have to
define an application form.

1 Note
Note that the function modules for dunning activities for correspondence dunning use a different interface than the function
modules for dunning activities for dunning open items.

Then assign the dunning activities to the dunning levels of a dunning procedure in the activity Configure Dunning Procedure. You
can assign a dunning activity to different dunning levels of different dunning procedures as well assigning different dunning
activities to one dunning level.

When you execute the dunning activity run, the function modules defined for the activities for a dunning level are called up.

Dunning activities are industry-specific. However, you can also define installation-specific activities.

ee Example
Possible dunning activities are:
e Creation of a dunning letter
e Creation of a note by a clerk
e Submission of items to a collection agency
e Termination of a contract
e Setting a lock
e Creation of collection work items

e Disconnection of a Service
